units.source_text: 没有热水洗澡，打乱了我的计划。

en.t: The lack of hot water for a bath upset my plans.

units.source_text: 我自然早就想到，只有在我和朝仓轮流洗澡的时候，我和他才会分别与道子两个人独处。

en.t: Naturally, I had long since realized that only when Asakura and I took turns bathing would he and I each have a chance to be alone with Michiko.

units.source_text: 在站前旅馆里吃早餐的时候，我和朝仓谈了这件事，并且和他约定了。

en.t: While we were eating breakfast at the inn in front of the station, Asakura and I talked about this and made an agreement.
